beats.text: Golden Knights' Jack Eichel: No. 15 to No. 5 in one week.
Five points in his last three games, and Vegas didn't lose any of them in regulation.
That has him lurking just outside our top 3, behind Bouchard and Kaprizov.
Vegas fans, is Eichel a real Hart contender?
